title: Filter Element Change

steps.glance: Stop pump and close valves V1 and V2
steps.body: Stop the pump and close inlet valve V1 and outlet valve V2.
quotes: Stop the pump and close inlet valve V1 and outlet valve V2.

steps.glance: Remove drain plug and drain 0.5 L
steps.body: Place a drip tray under the bowl and remove the drain plug to drain about 0.5 L of fluid.
quotes: 2. Place a drip tray under the bowl and remove the drain plug to drain about 0.5 L of fluid.

diagram.alt: Drain plug M10 at bottom of filter bowl

steps.glance: Loosen two M5 clamp screws and remove bowl
steps.body: Loosen the two M5 bowl clamp screws and remove the filter bowl.
steps.warning: Relieve line pressure before opening the filter bowl.
quotes: Loosen the two M5 bowl clamp screws and remove the filter bowl.
Relieve line pressure before opening the filter bowl.

diagram.alt: Clamp screw M5 locations on the filter bowl assembly.

steps.body: Replace the filter element with a new element HX2-420 (25 um rating).
quotes: Replace the filter element with a new element HX2-420 (25 µm rating).

diagram.alt: Element HX2-420 installed inside the filter bowl.

steps.glance: Torque two M5 bowl clamp screws to 3 N-m
steps.body: Refit the bowl and torque the two M5 bowl clamp screws to 3 N-m (Table 1).
steps.checkpoint: Torque the two M5 bowl clamp screws to 3 N-m
quotes: Refit the bowl and torque the two M5 bowl clamp screws to 3 N-m (Table 1).

diagram.alt: Clamp screw M5 locations for torquing.

steps.glance: Refit drain plug and torque to 8 N-m
steps.body: Refit the drain plug and torque it to 8 N-m.
quotes: 6. Refit the drain plug and torque it to 8 N-m (Table 1).

diagram.alt: Drain plug M10 at bottom of filter bowl

steps.glance: Open V1, then V2, and watch seam for 60 s
steps.body: Open V1, then V2, and watch the bowl seam for leaks for 60 s.
steps.checkpoint: Watch the bowl seam for leaks for 60 s
quotes: Open V1, then V2, and watch the bowl seam for leaks for 60 s.

warnings: WARNING: Relieve line pressure before opening the filter bowl. Never open the bowl while the pump runs.
